description: This file provides functions for normalizing and identifying WhatsApp target identifiers, including JIDs and phone numbers, with regex patterns and string processing.

methods.name: stripWhatsAppTargetPrefixes
methods.description: Removes 'whatsapp:' prefix from a string, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isWhatsAppGroupJid
methods.description: Checks if a string is a WhatsApp group JID ending with '@g.us' and valid local part.

methods.name: isWhatsAppUserTarget
methods.description: Checks if a string matches WhatsApp user JID patterns.

methods.name: extractUserJidPhone
methods.description: Extracts phone number part from various WhatsApp JID formats.

methods.name: normalizeWhatsAppTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a WhatsApp target string to a standard format or null.

methods.name: normalizeWhatsAppMessagingTarget
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a raw WhatsApp target string, returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeWhatsAppAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Normalizes an array of entries into valid WhatsApp targets, handling '*' as special case.

methods.name: looksLikeWhatsAppTargetId
methods.description: Determines if a string resembles a WhatsApp target ID.
